name: CAFlow — ITD Portal Autofill
description: Fills the Income Tax e-Filing login and confirms the Secure Access Message (stops at the final submit — that click, and CAPTCHA/OTP if one appears, stay manual). Also attempts, on request from CAFlow's Verify on ITD Portal button, the Payment History click-path, then opens each in-quarter challan's own View Details page to read its authoritative fields — no download, no upload.
